newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV STRIKER IVIC OUT WITH KNEE INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV STRIKER IVIC OUT WITH KNEE INJURY.

text.p: Yugoslav international striker Ilia Ivic could miss at least the next three weeks of the season after injuring his knee in Olympiakos' Greek League victory over Kavala on Sunday, a club official said on Monday.

Ivic, rated as one of the top strikers in the championship despite only scoring seven times this season, might need surgery on the knee although he should recover by the time Yugoslavia play the Czech Republic in their next World Cup group six qualifier on April 2.
Ivic, formerly with Red Star Belgrade, has helped Olympiakos into first place in the standings, just ahead of arch-rivals Panathinaikos.
